notes: 25 candidates: 9 program-list, 0 single-record, 16 not-a-list. All institutions kept as given by host. UCLA Anderson has four strong list pages: /degrees/phd/placement (academic placements 1999-2012 by area, with DOTM section), /degrees/phd/dissertations (author+title, no years), and the 2012-13 and 2018-19 job-market candidate pages; the three UCLA media-relations pages marked program-list are press releases that list a single graduating class (2001, 2003, 2005) with placements, so they are small year-specific lists rather than placement archives. The 2001 press release and the 2018-19 Chicago Booth job-market page contain no operations candidates. The UF DBA 'where are they now' page is a news feature naming only three DBA (not PhD) graduates; the integrator may prefer to treat it as out of population. The UF ISOM placement page names hiring universities only. The Groningen management-faculty index has 6 pages below it (year listings) that were not in this batch and may hold dissertation lists for 1972-2007.
